title: Cutoff on non-negatively curved chains without symmetric support condition
summary: We establish a cutoff criterion for finite Markov chains with non-negative Bakry--Émery curvature without assuming that the support of the transition matrix is symmetric. This extends a criterion of Salez based on a refined product condition. For each allowed transition, we consider a shortest directed path from its endpoint back to its starting point. Our cutoff criterion depends on the maximum length of these paths. We also obtain a discrete-time counterpart for lazy chains.
